sources.title: 經濟部商工登記公示資料查詢：麗升能源科技股份有限公司
sources.locator: Name-change record: “modified Company Name on 2024/06/07”; prior entry dated 2024/04/16 remains 華鎂鑫科技股份有限公司
sources.note: Official registry dates the registered name modification to June 7, 2024.

sources.title: 櫃買中心：麗升能源科技股份有限公司更名換發新股公告
sources.note: Confirms the subsequent share-replacement and trading dates; it does not support a May effective date.

sources.title: 華鎂鑫股東會通過更名為麗升能源科技(股)
sources.note: Reproduces a MOPS material announcement reporting that the shareholders’ meeting approved the name change on May 24, 2024.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
Official registry and TPEX records resolve the distinction between the May shareholder approval and the June registered name change; no unresolved material atom remains.
The May 24 approval-date evidence is a secondary reproduction of a MOPS announcement; the June 7 registration date and prior name are confirmed by the official MOEA registry.
The TPEX notice concerns the later replacement of shares and start of trading under the renamed company; it is not the source for the May approval date.
